modelOverview: Launched in 1996, the Tank Française reworked Louis Cartier's original 1917 Tank silhouette into a squarer, more architectural case fully integrated with a link bracelet. Cartier redesigned the line in 2023 with a slimmer case, a faceted crown and a reworked bracelet, and the Small model is the most compact of the current sizes, offered in steel on a quartz movement.

WSTA0065.materials: Stainless steel case and integrated steel bracelet; sapphire crystal
WSTA0065.dial: Silvered sunray dial with Roman numerals and blued-steel sword-shaped hands; faceted steel crown set with a synthetic cabochon-shaped spinel
WSTA0065.description: The WSTA0065 is the Small Tank Française in steel from Cartier's 2023 redesign of the model, pairing a silvered sunray dial and blued sword hands with the integrated steel bracelet and faceted spinel-set crown that define the current generation. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.

variants.Steel – Silver Dial: Small Tank Française in stainless steel with a silvered sunray Roman-numeral dial and blued-steel sword hands, on the integrated steel bracelet of the 2023 generation.
